name: Leaders pilot: Michael Truell archival biography, Cursor-building story and dated net worth
text: Follow growth/EDITORIAL_GUIDELINES.md, growth/leaders/TEMPLATE.md and growth/leaders/michael-truell.md. Produce one private profile answering who is Michael Truell and what is his net worth. Proposed title: Who Is Michael Truell? Cursor's Co-Founder and His Net Worth. Forbes profile retrieved Oct9,2026 shows net worth estimate USD2.8billion as of10/9/26; preserve estimate/source/date and recheck at publication. It identifies him as Cursor cofounder/CEO and founding in2022 with three MIT friends. Cursor's Aug14,2026 company announcement confirms acquisition completion. Do not invent personal stake percentages, compensation, birth date, education/graduation dates, stock class or cash proceeds. Forbes' separate estimated share consideration at closing is not the same metric as current net worth. Use explicit source-ID mapping, typed person/company roles and null unknowns. Link contextually and through relatedStories to /who-owns-cursor/; include /cursor-salary/ as related company pay evidence, not his salary. The general renderer does not parse Markdown in section text; use actual rich-text links or typed link modules. Portrait is a new AI illustration from a likeness reference, matching existing monochrome Leaders style; final local asset is to be attached and human likeness/crop/credit review is required. The original WSJ reference photograph remains private and is not republished. No invented quotes/interview. One observation does not justify an interpolated wealth chart. Full duplicate/path check, real author and editor approval remain required. Use the supplied draft as a first pass and deepen biography only with verified sources. Generated output remains a draft. Updated researched draft now includes Horace Mann science-fair announcement, Fido and NYCSL credits, Halite and Two Sigma records, contemporary 2023 Hacker News founder comments, shadow workspace engineering, funding milestones and an explicitly attributed investor retrospective. Follow growth/leaders/michael-truell-evidence.md. Preserve original editorial analysis and linked evidence beside factual claims. Do not reduce this to a generic biography or label public-source synthesis as a new interview. Reuse app/public/reference/michael-truell-illustration-v1.png. User editorial standard: write as a financial investigator, foreground distinctive documented findings, and weave descriptive source and internal links into sentences. Never append source labels after periods in article prose. Apply growth/EDITORIAL_GUIDELINES.md. Include our scoped four-round funding calculation: USD3.365bn; final round 68.4%, with inputs, formula and company-reported basis in the evidence ledger. Do not call this independently audited or lifetime funding. Net-worth presentation must follow growth/leaders/NET_WORTH_MODULE.md and michael-truell-net-worth.json: one concise paragraph, one dated USD2.8bn snapshot, two source-linked event entries, and a short methodology note. The August closing event is not a historical net-worth data point; do not graph its USD2.4bn estimated stock consideration as prior personal wealth. Use the homepage EditorialChart component/design for all graphs. Methodology must describe our independent public-record research, source checks and reproducible calculations, while attributing personal wealth to Forbes and stating the private-balance-sheet limitation. Follow the updated NET_WORTH_MODULE.md.
